responsibility: Implements Linux target helper logic that decides which standard-library function classes are available for the active libc configuration. In particular it reports broad support for glibc and musl, and limited C94/C99-misc/sincos support for Bionic, through linux_libc_has_function. This file is a small target runtime-capability helper rather than a full Linux target configuration header.
same_name_distinction: This is the only compiled implementation file in the linux same-name group: it defines linux_libc_has_function, the runtime libc-capability test used by Linux configurations, whereas linux.h defines the Linux libc-selection macros/spec policy and linux.opt declares the -mglibc/-muclibc/-mbionic/-mmusl options that feed that policy.
